units.source_text: 第一次去拜访先生时，他不在家。

en.t: The first time I went to visit Sensei, he was not at home.

units.source_text: 第二次去，我记得是第二周的星期天。

en.t: The second time I went, I remember, was the Sunday of the following week.

units.source_text: 那天晴空万里，是个怡人的好天气，谁知先生又不在家。

en.t: That day the sky was perfectly clear and the weather was pleasant, but to my surprise Sensei was again not at home.

units.source_text: 在镰仓时，曾听先生亲口说过，无论什么时候，他大抵都在家，更何况他还说过讨厌外出。

en.t: When we were in Kamakura, I had heard Sensei say with his own mouth that he was usually at home at any time, and moreover that he disliked going out.

units.source_text: 可是我来了两次，两次都不得见，想起那番话，心里涌出一股莫名的不满。

en.t: Yet I had come twice and failed to see him both times, and when I remembered those words, a vague dissatisfaction rose in my heart.

units.source_text: 我并没有马上离开，而是看着女佣的脸，犹豫不决地站在门口。

en.t: I did not leave at once, but stood hesitating in the doorway while looking at the maid's face.

units.source_text: 这位女佣还记得我上次递过名片，便让我先等一下，自己又进了屋。

en.t: The maid still remembered that I had handed in my card the previous time, so she asked me to wait a moment and went back inside.

units.source_text: 于是，一位夫人模样的女人出来了，是一位很漂亮的太太。

en.t: Then a woman who appeared to be the lady of the house came out; she was a very beautiful wife.

units.source_text: 夫人很客气地告诉我先生的去处。

en.t: The lady courteously told me where Sensei had gone.

units.source_text: 她说，先生有个习惯，每月的这一天，都要去杂司谷墓地祭奠一位逝者。

en.t: She said that Sensei had a custom of going on this day every month to Zoshigaya Cemetery to pay respects to someone who had died.

units.source_text: “他刚刚出去了，大概有十来分钟的时间。”夫人满脸歉意地对我说。

en.t: He has only just gone out, perhaps ten minutes ago, the lady said to me with an apologetic expression.

units.source_text: 我朝着热闹的街市方向走了没多远，突然想到，不妨我也顺便到杂司谷去散散步，说不定会遇到先生呢。

en.t: After walking only a short distance toward the busy streets, it suddenly occurred to me that I might as well take a walk to Zoshigaya too, and perhaps I would meet Sensei there.

units.source_text: 出于这样的想法，我马上转身往回走。

en.t: With that thought, I immediately turned around and went back.
